Gutama Girja Urago is a young agricultural economist who enjoys playing with R and has a keen interest in quantitative analysis without leaving qualitative aside. Currently, he is pursuing the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Degree organized by six European Universities hosting at Ghent University.

  University = c("Ghent University", "Ondokuz Mayis University", "Haramaya University"),

) |>
